name: Pretend to be AI
desc:
Originally this game was centered around:
"
Pretend to be AI is a puzzle roleplay game where you can either:
- Play as a detective, trying to figure out if the person you’re talking to is an AI.
- Play as an impostor, attempting to convince the detective that you are an AI.
"
However, due to TOS and legal changes requiring the disclosure of all AI interactions, the game is non functional right now. Thanks to everyone who played.

creator.name: Pretend To Be AI | Torke Software
